landing.heroSubtitle: TimeDeo is a community where you swap hours of help. Teach guitar, get your sink fixed. One hour is always worth one hour — for everyone.
landing.oneLiner: The big idea: <1>one hour of your time</1> is worth one hour of anyone else’s.
landing.howTitle: Earn hours by helping. Spend them getting help.
landing.howDesc: There are only two things to do on TimeDeo — and your balance connects them.
landing.step1Body: Teach a language, fix a leak, design a logo. When someone books your time, you earn hours.
landing.step2Title: Spend hours on help you need
landing.step2Body: Browse people offering their time and book them. Your hours cover it — no card, no invoice.
landing.step3Body: One hour of your time equals one hour of anyone’s. A surgeon’s hour and a student’s hour are equal here.
landing.whyTitle: A fairer way to get things done
landing.whyDesc: Money leaves people out. Time doesn’t — everyone has some to give.
landing.why1Body: Everyone starts with time. You don’t need cash to get help — just a skill to share.
landing.why2Body: No haggling, no hourly rates. One hour is one hour, so help stays fair for all.
landing.why3Body: Trades happen between neighbours. You meet people and build real, local trust.
landing.why4Body: When you book, your hours are held safely and only released once you say the job’s done.
landing.catTitle: People are trading all kinds of time
landing.ctaTitle: You already have something to trade: your time.
landing.ctaDesc: Start with a few free hours, help someone this week, and get help when you need it.
